summary: Sharplink, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its share repurchase program and Ethereum (ETH) acquisition. The board approved a $1.5B share repurchase program on August 21, 2025. From June 24-26, 2026, the company repurchased 2,132,773 shares at an average price of $4.69 per share. Separately, it acquired 10,000 ETH for ~$16.1M at $1,611 per ETH using proceeds from a June 23 registered direct offering. As of June 28, the company held 886,725 ETH, mostly staked. The filing is a routine disclosure of capital allocation decisions. Watch for further updates on share buyback execution and ETH staking yields; no deal-specific arbitrage exists as these are issuer-driven actions with no counterparty terms.
